Biomedical Sciences & Oncology Research

Career Journey

Experience & Education

My research appointments, academic milestones, and biological discovery background.

🔬 Work Experience

March 2025 – Present

Post-doctoral Researcher

Chung-Ang University

Investigating patient-derived ovarian cancer organoids, patient-derived tumor microenvironment (TME) models, and uncovering the underlying mechanisms driving resistance to platinum-based chemotherapy.

March 2020 – February 2025

Ph.D. Candidate & Researcher

Jeonbuk National University

Investigated the pivotal role of Casein Kinase 1 alpha in secondary endometrial cancer cells following prolonged tamoxifen exposure. Analyzed RNA-seq data from Alzheimer's disease models and conducted statistical evaluations of randomized clinical trials.

October 2018 – May 2019

Graduate Researcher

Hue University of Science

Isolated clinical pathogens and established minimum effective concentrations of synthesized silver nanoparticles required for microbial eradication.
